A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a deterministic response can only be obtained for a very special input time course and that the semi-deterministic output properties are the most general ones that can be obtained with an HH-model.

the interspike-intervall function is a valid description tool for neuronal responses, provided that the output properties are not stochastic but follow systematic rules, and that the input current density is large enough to generate spikes.
